column1: # Every version that reached main's tip, oldest first. One line per version:
#   version<TAB>date<TAB>source
# This file is the authority for "what shipped". It is APPENDED IN THE SAME
# COMMIT AS THE VERSION BUMP, alongside the CHANGELOG entry — see CLAUDE.md's
# "Releasing (two repos)". tests/changelog-coverage.test.js fails the suite when
# the manifest's version is missing here, so the append cannot be forgotten.
# Why a recorded file rather than a git walk: reconstructing this from
# `git rev-list --first-parent` is not merely lossy, it is unstable. A branch
# that merges main into itself and then becomes main's tip moves everything main
# carried since the fork point onto the second parent, where the walk never
# looks. Versions therefore LEAVE the reconstructed set as later merges land,
# and the same repository gives contradictory answers depending on which merge
# happened last (#144).
# Backfilled 2026-08-06 by unioning the first-parent walks from three refs known
# to have been main's tip (origin/main, 65531d88, 3bf55c68) with the marketplace
# repo's per-commit plugins[0].version — an independent repository, one commit
# per release, written at ship time. `source` records which of those bore
# witness; `release` marks every line appended at ship time since.
